Marta R.: Heads-up — scheduling a 60m maintenance window for az21 this Thu 02:00–03:00 UTC. Purpose: PSU firmware patch + soft RMM reboot on r01–r08. We'll do rolling cordon/drain 2 nodes at a time. Expected impact: brief (~2–6 min) task evictions per node, no customer-facing downtime expected thanks to cross-az routing. Please ack if you see risk.

Diego H.: Ack. Can we avoid hitting Dedicated reserved pools?

Marta R.: Yes, plan excludes Dedicated pools; we'll mark them with a taint and nodeSelector. We'll target ephemeral and spot backfill nodes first.

Lina K.: How will this affect prefix/KV cache? If we evict nodes we'll lose hot KV leading to latency spikes for long chat sessions.

Marta R.: Good call — we'll warm cache on target nodes pre-drain using a warmup job. Two passes: one lightweight then a second full warm.

Oncall Bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1417. Autogenerated timeline + paging configured for >5% 500s.

Ashok P.: What's the plan for routing? Can we route traffic away from az21 for the window? That's heavier cost but safer.

Marta R.: Routing: prefer az22/az23 and only use az21 as fallback at 95% capacity. Keeps latency SLOs. Cost estimate: ~+12% for that hour due to cross-az egress. Diego, can we cover that from ops budget?

Diego H.: +12% OK. Also ensure model pinning for critical variants — avoid auto-quantized fallbacks during window.

Marta R.: Agreed — pushing config: service.routing.prefer = ['az22','az23']; service.fallback_threshold = 0.95

SRE Rotation: Add a canary: first run on r01–r02, wait 10m, validate pod restarts <3 and p50 latency delta <8ms. If fail, abort and roll back.

Marta R.: Plan note added to runbook. If canary passes we proceed in 15m cohorts. Drain sequence & commands below.

Marta R.: ```
kubectl cordon node-az21-r01
kubectl drain node-az21-r01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# warmup job (run on node after cordon, before drain):
kubectl run --rm -i --restart=Never warmup --image=alpine -- ash -c "for i in 1 2 3; do curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/cache/warm || true; sleep 5; done"
```

Lina K.: Can we add a brief eval run after the canary to assert generation quality? 5 sample prompts per high-traffic model.

Marta R.: Done. Lina will own eval check and post pass/fail in this thread.

Lina K.: Will run eval immediately after canary and report.

Ashok P.: Also cc'ing finance for egress cost bump. I'll ping them and add the estimate to the ticket.

Diego H.: One more request — adjust autoscaler buffers to avoid aggressive scale-down during drain. Set minReplicas +2 for affected deployments.

Marta R.: Will deploy autoscaler tweak at T-15.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: paging schedule rotates to Diego H. during maintenance window.

Marta R.: Thanks everyone. I'll post start + finish timestamps here before we begin. Canary scheduled for 02:00 UTC on Thursday. If anything blocks, raise in this thread. :thumbsup:
